site.title: SkillVerse
site.tagline: Structured, chapter-based guides on RTL Design, SystemVerilog, UVM, Formal Verification, DFT, AMBA & OBI protocols, RISC-V, and everyday engineering tooling.
site.meta_description: SkillVerse by Squared Studio - a structured, open-source knowledge base covering RTL Design, SystemVerilog, UVM, Formal Verification, DFT, AMBA protocols, RISC-V, and tooling.
site.og_title: SkillVerse - Squared Studio Open-Source Learning Hub
site.og_description_template: %s structured courses and %s chapters on RTL Design, SystemVerilog, UVM, AXI/ACE/CHI, Formal Verification, DFT, and engineering toolchains.

Learning_Pathways.title: Learning Pathways & Career Roadmaps
Learning_Pathways.desc: Role-by-role roadmaps for RTL Design, Design Verification, Formal, FPGA, DFT, and SoC Architects — wired directly to SkillVerse courses.

SystemVerilog.title: SystemVerilog
SystemVerilog.desc: Hardware modeling, interfaces, OOP testbenches, randomization, and assertions.

RTL_Design.title: RTL Design
RTL_Design.desc: Synchronous digital design, microarchitecture, FSMs, pipelining, CDC, and synthesis.

RTL_Design_Verification.title: RTL Design Verification
RTL_Design_Verification.desc: Simulation methodologies, layered testbenches, coverage, and verification closure.

uvm.title: UVM
uvm.desc: Universal Verification Methodology phases, agents, sequences, scoreboards, and RAL.

UPF_CPF.title: UPF / CPF Low-Power Design
UPF_CPF.desc: IEEE 1801 UPF and Si2 CPF power domains, isolation, retention, level shifters, PSTs, and power-aware verification.

CDC_RDC.title: CDC / RDC (Clock & Reset Crossings)
CDC_RDC.desc: Metastability, MTBF, 2-FF and pulse synchronizers, MCP/DMUX, Gray-code async FIFOs, reset trees, RDC isolation, and static/formal sign-off.

GLS.title: GLS (Gate-Level Simulation)
GLS.desc: Standard-cell models, SDF back-annotation, zero-delay vs timing GLS, pulse filtering, X-propagation, timing debug, PG UPF, DFT/MBIST, and sign-off.

Formal_Verification.title: Formal Verification
Formal_Verification.desc: SVA properties, bounded model checking, induction, and formal sign-off.

DFT.title: Design for Testability (DFT)
DFT.desc: Scan chains, ATPG, BIST, boundary scan, and silicon test readiness.

APB_Protocol.title: APB Protocol
APB_Protocol.desc: Advanced Peripheral Bus register access, transfers, and low-power interfaces.

UART_Protocol.title: UART Protocol
UART_Protocol.desc: Asynchronous serial framing, baud generation, FIFO buffering, and verification.

OBI.title: OBI Protocol
OBI.desc: Open Bus Interface handshake protocol used in open-source RISC-V cores.

AXI_Protocol.title: AXI Protocol
AXI_Protocol.desc: AMBA AXI4 burst transactions, channel handshakes, ordering, and VIP design.

ACE_Protocol.title: ACE Protocol
ACE_Protocol.desc: AXI Coherency Extensions, snoop channels, cache states, and barrier transactions.

CHI_Protocol.title: CHI Protocol
CHI_Protocol.desc: Coherent Hub Interface packetized fabric, RN/HN/SN nodes, and flit flows.

RISC_V_Assembly.title: RISC-V Assembly
RISC_V_Assembly.desc: RV32I/RV64I instruction formats, calling conventions, CSRs, and bare-metal code.

Electronics.title: Electronics
Electronics.desc: Semiconductor physics, diodes, MOSFETs, BJTs, op-amps, and logic families.

AMS.title: AMS (Analog & Mixed-Signal)
AMS.desc: CMOS biasing, OTAs, comparators, DAC/ADC converters, PLLs, PMIC/LDOs, SerDes, SPICE, Verilog-A/SV-RNM, co-simulation, and analog layout sign-off.

FPGA.title: FPGA Engineering & Architecture
FPGA.desc: CLB/LUT fabric, FPGA-friendly RTL, BRAM/URAM/DSP48, MMCM clocking, XDC timing closure, high-speed IO/transceivers, SoC FPGAs, DFX, prototyping, HLS, and ILA debug.

Vivado.title: Vivado
Vivado.desc: AMD/Xilinx FPGA synthesis, XDC constraints, simulation, ILA debug, and bitstreams.

C.title: C Programming
C.desc: Pointers, memory layout, structs, bitwise operations, and systems-level C.

Python.title: Python
Python.desc: Scripting, automation, verification helpers, data structures, and tooling workflows.

bash.title: Bash
bash.desc: Shell scripting, text pipelines, job control, and regression automation.

Unix_Terminal.title: Unix Terminal
Unix_Terminal.desc: Filesystem navigation, permissions, processes, SSH, and CLI productivity.

git.title: Git & GitHub CI/CD
git.desc: Branching, rebasing, conflict resolution, bisect, collaborative workflows, and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.

Makefile.title: Makefile
Makefile.desc: Dependency graphs, pattern rules, variables, and simulation build automation.

VIM.title: VIM
VIM.desc: Modal editing, motions, visual block macros, buffers, and HDL productivity.

Circuits.title: Circuits
Circuits.desc: Foundational analog and digital circuit analysis, RLC networks, amplifiers, and switching circuits.

DDR_Protocol.title: DDR Protocol
DDR_Protocol.desc: JEDEC DDR4/DDR5 timing fundamentals, controller scheduling, DFI interfaces, and PHY initialization.

I2C_Protocol.title: I2C Protocol
I2C_Protocol.desc: Two-wire serial bus arbitration, clock stretching, multi-master addressing, and controller RTL.

PCIe_Protocol.title: PCIe Protocol
PCIe_Protocol.desc: Physical layer signaling, TLP/DLLP transaction routing, LTSSM link training, and Gen5/Gen6 verification.

SPI_Protocol.title: SPI Protocol
SPI_Protocol.desc: Serial Peripheral Interface clocking modes, full-duplex framing, QSPI extensions, and controller design.

USB_Protocol.title: USB Protocol
USB_Protocol.desc: Universal Serial Bus packet framing, enumeration, endpoints, and high-speed host/device architecture.
